notes: [P1] edge/coupling: rangePreview (src/game.js) decides whether empty grass gets a ring by calling canPlace. The brief only asks for null on a path cell or with no hover. If canPlace also checks anything else, such as gold or the tower kind, the grass preview will vanish whenever placement is blocked for that reason. Only the source diffs were rendered, so I could not check what canPlace actually tests, and no test covers grass that is free but blocked for some other reason. Consider an explicit path, bounds and occupancy check, or add a test that pins this behaviour down.

[P2] design: drawRange (src/render.js) fills the circle with THEME.rangeFill as well as stroking it dashed. The brief asks for a faint outline. The fill is very faint (alpha 0.07) and the comment says it follows the artboard, but the tests only check the stroke colour, so the fill is an untested extra beyond the brief.

[P2] structure: render.js now imports rangePreview from game.js, so the drawing layer depends on the game-logic module. There is no cycle today, but render could instead receive the ring precomputed by main.js, keeping render free of game imports.
